en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing an ornate, richly decorated small palace or pavilion in an eclectic Ottoman/Baroque style, surrounded by trees. The façade is heavily ornamented with reliefs, columns, and an elaborate central entrance reached by side stairs. The card is filled with handwritten script across the margins and over the image. Printed captions include the place name in French and in English/Latin script.
